texts.zh:
终于，星海参议院投票通过授予[custodian.GetName]紧急监管权。在一个向全星系广播的官方典礼上，我们被任命为星海共同体监管人。

作为同侪之首，我们负责保卫星海共同体的安全，抵御一切来自内部或外部的潜在威胁。我们在整个共同体的各项事务上被赋予了极大的权力，并且可以提出特殊的议案。
texts.en:
At last, the Galactic Senate has voted to bestow emergency Custodianship powers upon the [custodian.GetName]. In an official ceremony broadcast across the galaxy, we were appointed Custodians of the Galactic Community.

As the first among equals, we have been charged with safeguarding the Galactic Community from all potential threats, be they internal or external, who would seek it harm. We have been granted vast powers in all Community matters and can now propose special resolutions.

texts.zh:
星海参议院投票通过授予[custodian.GetName]紧急监管权。在一个向全星系广播的官方典礼上，他们被任命为星海共同体监管人。

作为同侪之首，[custodian.GetSpeciesName]政府负责保卫星海共同体的安全，抵御一切来自内部或外部的潜在威胁。他们在整个共同体的各项事务上被赋予了极大的权力，并且可以提出特殊的议案。
texts.en:
The Galactic Senate has voted to bestow emergency Custodianship powers upon the [custodian.GetName]. In a ceremony broadcast across the galaxy, they were appointed the official Custodians of the Galactic Community.

As the first among equals, the [custodian.GetSpeciesName] government is now charged with safeguarding the Galactic Community from all potential threats, be they internal or external, who would seek it harm. They have been granted vast powers in all Community matters and can now propose special resolutions.

label.zh: 现在我们可以大有作为了。
label.en: Now we can get things done.

tooltips.en: The [custodian.GetName] are now Custodians of the Galactic Community.

label.zh: 让我们看看这样会如何。
label.en: We shall see how this works out.

tooltips.en: The [custodian.GetName] are now Custodians of the Galactic Community.

texts.zh: 我们作为星海共同体监管人的任期已经结束。监管人职能终止，我们的特殊权力也解除了，当然我们依然还维持着在星系理事会中的席位。
texts.en: Our term as the Custodians of the Galactic Community has reached its end. The Custodianship has been terminated and our special powers rescinded, although we have retained our seat on the Galactic Council.

texts.zh: 随着他们的任期结束，[former_custodians.GetName]放弃了他们作为星海共同体监管人的地位。他们的特殊权力也废除了，当然他们依然还维持着在星系理事会中的席位。
texts.en: With their term at an end, the [former_custodians.GetName] has given up their status as the Custodians of the Galactic Community. Their special powers have been rescinded, and they are now considered a regular member of the Galactic Council.

tooltips.en: The [From.GetName] are no longer Custodians of the Galactic Community.

title.zh: 泛星系防卫军暂停行动

texts.zh: 由于星海监管人的职位现在空缺，泛星系防卫军设立了一个独立的指挥架构。他们依然致力于保护星海共同体，泛星系防卫军的指挥高层宣誓将继续巡逻成员国的恒星系。
texts.en: With the office of the Galactic Custodian now vacant, the Galactic Defense Force has established an independent command structure. They remain dedicated towards the protection of the Community, and GDF High Command has vowed to maintain their patrols of member systems.

label.zh: 他们的警觉令人肃然起敬。

title.zh: 泛星系防卫军向监管人报告

texts.zh: 由于我们已经肩负了星海监管人的职责，泛星系防卫军现在被纳入我们的指挥架构。他们等待我们在未来的进一步指示。
texts.en: As we have assumed the office of the Galactic Custodian, the Galactic Defense Force has been folded into our command structure. They will now look to us for future orders.

tooltips.zh: 所有泛星系防卫军下辖的舰队现在受我们指挥。
tooltips.en: All GDF fleets are now under our command.
